title: ProcessingRequest
description: Async processing request published by REST endpoints to the agent-requests topic. Record key = processingId. A consumer (agent) processes it and publishes an AgentEvent carrying the same processingId as correlationId to the agent-events topic; the UI listener (SSE GET /api/events/stream) completes on it.

processingId.description: Processing UUID generated by the REST endpoint. Correlates the request, the A2A task (taskId) and the completion event.

type.description: Request kind. CHAT: master agent chat turn (POST /api/chat). AGENT: direct agent execution (POST /api/agents/{name}/execute or A2A message/send).

conversationId.description: CHAT only: id of the conversation the reply is appended to (the REST endpoint creates it before publishing, so it is never null).

preset.description: CHAT only: master agent preset id, or null for the default preset.

agentName.description: AGENT only: name of the target agent.

instruction.description: AGENT only: instruction for the agent.

taskId.description: AGENT only: A2A task id for message/send (polled via tasks/get); null for direct REST execution.

payload.description: AGENT only: extra agent payload (e.g. pdfPath). Empty map when unused.
